character_base: A fluffy corgi puppy with rich chocolate brown and cream white fur, deep reddish-brown on back and ears (NOT yellow, NOT golden, NOT amber, NOT orange), pure soft cream white on chest and inner face, large perky triangle ears, sparkling bright green eyes with white catchlight highlights, small dark round nose, chubby chibi round body with very short stubby legs, gentle happy smile with tiny pink tongue — soft watercolor illustration style, muted cool pastel tones, no harsh saturation, warm and cozy atmosphere, Studio Ghibli-inspired cute style, no text, no watermark, 1024x1024px square

energetic.label: 朝の名言
energetic.scene: standing proudly in soft morning sunlight streaming through a window, tail wagging energetically, mouth open in a big happy smile, eyes sparkling with excitement
energetic.background: cozy Japanese living room with warm golden morning light, soft curtains, wooden floor
energetic.mood: bright, hopeful, energetic start of the day

dreamy.label: 引き寄せ
dreamy.scene: sitting on a fluffy cloud, eyes half-closed in a dreamy expression, one paw gently raised as if reaching for a glowing star, soft smile
dreamy.background: pastel blue sky with soft cotton clouds, gentle sparkles and stars around

proud.label: 自己肯定感
proud.scene: sitting upright with chest puffed out proudly, big confident smile, eyes bright and shining, surrounded by small flowers
proud.background: soft green meadow with blooming pastel wildflowers, gentle sunlight

determined.label: メンタル強化
determined.scene: standing on top of a small hill with a serious but gentle expression, one front paw raised slightly, looking forward with quiet determination
determined.background: misty mountain path with soft light breaking through clouds, peaceful nature

cheerful.label: 習慣づくり
cheerful.scene: sitting next to a small open notebook and a tiny cup of tea, looking up with a cheerful eager expression, tail visible and fluffy
cheerful.background: cozy Japanese kotatsu corner, warm afternoon light, simple wooden desk
cheerful.mood: cozy productivity, gentle motivation, warm daily routine

comforting.label: 休息・癒し
comforting.scene: curled up softly on a cushion with eyes gently closed, peaceful sleeping face, one paw tucked under chin
comforting.background: soft warm blanket, dim evening lamp light, cozy indoor Japanese room
comforting.mood: gentle rest, permission to relax, tender comfort

curious.label: 気づき・発見
curious.scene: head tilted to one side with wide curious eyes, one ear perked higher than the other, small mouth slightly open in surprise
curious.background: simple soft pastel background with a few floating sparkles

empathetic.label: 共感・告白
empathetic.scene: sitting quietly with soft gentle eyes, slight melancholy expression but a small warm smile, looking directly at viewer
empathetic.background: soft rainy window scene, gentle blue-grey tones, indoor warmth
